exposure: Low-risk women undergoing echocardiography during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women without established heart disease who underwent echocardiography
finding: Among low-risk pregnant women, older age, higher parity, and a history of chronic hypertension were associated with a higher likelihood of echocardiographic abnormalities, which in turn predicted adverse obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: Echocardiographic abnormalities in pregnant women without established heart disease are associated with a higher likelihood of Cesarean section and preterm delivery.
